summary: NF525 fiscal subsystem is structurally sound and shows mature defense-in-depth. Three frozen services compose cleanly via lazy resolution (no constructor cycle): FiscalSequenceService → FiscalSealingService → AuditLogService → ZReportService → FiscalChainValidator. Allocation paths split correctly between kiosk-paid (FrontendOrderService::finalizePaidKioskOrder under config flag fiscal.kiosk_auto_allocate_sequence) and POS cash (at Z close window). Retry-on-failure is decoupled: failed allocations flagged via orders.fiscal_alloc_error_at column and reconciled by RetryFiscalAllocCommand running everyMinute (Kernel.php:143). Concurrency hardening is triple-layered: Cache::lock(fiscal_seq_b{n}, 5s, block 3s) + transactional SELECT MAX FOR UPDATE + DB UNIQUE(branch_id, fiscal_sequence_no). audit_logs writes use Cache::lock(audit_chain_b{n}, 10s, block 5s) + DB::transaction + UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) + single retry on collision. Z reports use Cache::lock(z_report_b{n}, 10s, block 4s) + lockForUpdate on the open Z row. Architecture is appropriately conservative: composition_snapshot is the immutable receipt SSOT (6 builder INSERTs: OrderService.php:466/821/1277, FrontendOrderService.php:441, PricingService.php:291, RefundWithCounterEntryService.php:136 copy-forward) — this is the per-line fiscal evidence that survives item catalog changes. ZReportService::aggregate() includes withTrashed() to honour the iter6 archive-then-soft-delete pattern without breaking the gap-free invariant (NF525 P0-FIX-1/2 owner G0-A). Layering is clean: FiscalSealingService isolates the actual HMAC, ZReportService delegates signing to it, FiscalChainValidator orchestrates dual-chain assertion. The recent Wave 3 heals (FiscalVerifyChainCommand --branch=0 sentinel rejection, --all sweep via Kernel::activeBranchIds(), distinct exit codes 0/1/2/3, z_reports chain integration) align operator CLI with monitor cron — single source of truth for 'active branch' is now Kernel::activeBranchIds() using whereIn(legacy 1, canonical 5). FiscalChainValidator bounded tail (default 500 rows) protects audit chain re-walk from O(N) inside Z open's 4s cache lock.

structural_observations.label: FROZEN file boundary is correctly enforced
structural_observations.evidence: Three core services (FiscalSequenceService, AuditLogService, ZReportService) listed in CLAUDE.md §7 frozen. FiscalChainValidator + FiscalSealingService not in frozen list — they wrap/extend the core without modifying frozen logic (correct pattern: extension over modification). Wave 3 verify-chain command lives in Console/Commands/ — outside frozen zone, adapts frozen public API.

structural_observations.label: Defense-in-depth pattern is consistently applied
structural_observations.evidence: Every fiscal write has 3 independent guards: cache lock (correctness optimization) + DB transaction + DB UNIQUE constraint (ultimate gate). Comments explicitly call out cache outage / split-brain / Redis-down scenarios as covered.

structural_observations.label: Telemetry surface is complete
structural_observations.evidence: Log::channel('fiscal') breadcrumbs at every write: audit_log.write (AuditLogService.php:167), z_report.open (ZReportService.php:125), z_report.close (ZReportService.php:253), orphan_paid_orders_in_window (ZReportService.php:602), stuck_closing (ZReportService.php:160). Includes hash_prefix (not full hash to avoid log leak) + duration_ms timing via [FISCAL_TIMING] context.

structural_observations.label: Sealed-Z guard prevents retro-mutation of closed periods
structural_observations.evidence: config/fiscal.php:117-121 sealed_z_guard_enabled (default true) gates OrderService::changeStatus → RETURNED inside a closed Z window — operators MUST use refund-with-counter-entry (RefundWithCounterEntryService) which copy-forwards composition_snapshot and creates mirror order in the current Z window.

structural_recommendations_v1_1.label: Multi-region cache lock — current Cache::lock is single-Redis
structural_recommendations_v1_1.rationale: Cache::lock blocks 3-5s per writer. In a future multi-region active-active deployment, two regions could each acquire 'fiscal_seq_b{n}' on their local Redis and fork the sequence (DB UNIQUE catches it, but the second writer fails the entire request). For V1 single-region this is fine; document as known limitation for multi-region future.
structural_recommendations_v1_1.frozen_impact: none — recommendation is for deploy doc / future config, not the service.

structural_recommendations_v1_1.label: Composition snapshot schema is not validated post-write
structural_recommendations_v1_1.rationale: OrderItem.php casts composition_snapshot to 'array' but there is no JSON schema check on the payload shape. A regression in PricingService::buildSnapshot could silently produce malformed JSON that breaks KDS/OSS rendering but still passes fiscal aggregation (which only reads order.total). Adding a schema validator (Laravel rule) in PricingService before INSERT would catch this earlier.
structural_recommendations_v1_1.frozen_impact: PricingService is not in frozen list — change is OK in V1.1 backlog.

structural_recommendations_v1_1.label: FiscalSealingService dev_sentinels list is duplicated across 3 assertion points
structural_recommendations_v1_1.rationale: AuditLogService::assertProductionSafe, ZReportService::assertProductionSafe, FiscalSealingService::assertProductionSafe — identical logic copy-pasted. Extract to a single FiscalSecretValidator trait or class. Frozen files would need to be touched, so this is V1.1 backlog ONLY with explicit owner gate.
structural_recommendations_v1_1.frozen_impact: Touches all 3 frozen services. Would require LOCK doc + cross-validation that extracted validator is bit-identical (HMAC unchanged).

specialist_verdict: GREEN — fiscal architecture is production-grade. No P0/P1 structural issues. 3 V1.1 cosmetic/refactor recommendations documented.
